asm_ida_com:
push    rbp
mov     rbp, rsp
sub     rsp, 20h
mov     [rbp+bnode], rdi
mov     [rbp+size], rsi
call    _plist_new_plist_data
mov     [rbp+data], rax
mov     rax, [rbp+data]
mov     dword ptr [rax+10h], 3
mov     rdi, [rbp+size]
add     rdi, 1
shl     rdi, 0; size
call    malloc
mov     rcx, rax
mov     rax, [rbp+data]
mov     [rax], rcx
mov     rax, [rbp+data]
mov     rdi, [rax]; dest
mov     rax, [rbp+bnode]
mov     rsi, [rax]; src
mov     rdx, [rbp+size]; n
call    memcpy
mov     rax, [rbp+data]
mov     rax, [rax]
mov     rcx, [rbp+size]
mov     byte ptr [rax+rcx], 0
mov     rax, [rbp+data]
mov     rdi, [rax]; s
call    strlen
mov     rcx, rax
mov     rax, [rbp+data]
mov     [rax+8], rcx
mov     rsi, [rbp+data]; data
xor     eax, eax
mov     edi, eax; parent
call    node_create
add     rsp, 20h
pop     rbp
retn
